WHEN B.SUBJECT_NO = '22210704' THEN 'ALT0402'
WHEN B.SUBJECT_NO = '22090101' THEN 'B09' ELSE NULL END) AS ptlFeeType,/**费用类型**/ B.BALANCE_DATE cdate, '999999' ptlFeePlace FROM BOK_BALANCE B WHERE B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.BALANCE_DATE = #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE}

WITH PRD AS ( select b.bookset_id,/** 账套代码**/ /** 数据字典：收益类型.预期收益 02 **/ case when c.channel_id is null then case when b.acct_mode = '02' then b.acct_subject_id else nvl(d.portfolio_id,b.acct_subject_id) end else case when e.acct_mode='02' then e.acct_subject_id else nvl(f.portfolio_id,e.acct_subject_id) end end portfolio_id, /** 组合代码**/ c.channel_id, /** 通道代码**/ nvl(c.bookset_id,b.bookset_id) f_bookset_id /** 上级账套代码**/ from bok_bookset b /** 账套表**/ left join bok_bookset_re c on b.bookset_id = c.bookset_id_son /** 母子账套关系**/ left join fin_product_add d on b.acct_subject_id = d.finprod_id /** 标的类金融产品附属表**/ left join bok_bookset e on c.bookset_id = e.bookset_id /** 账套表**/ left join fin_product_add f on e.acct_subject_id = f.finprod_id /** 标的类金融产品附属表**/ WHERE B.START_DATE <= #{happenDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND B.END_DATE > #{happenDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) SELECT PRD.portfolio_id portfolioId,/** 组合代码**/ nvl(PRD.channel_id,'999999') channelId,/** 通道ID**/ TEMP.bookset_id booksetId,/** 账套代码**/ TEMP.bok_detail_id bokDetailId,/** 业务明细代码**/ TEMP.BUSI_ID finprodId,/** 金融产品代码**/ TEMP.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE finprodType,/** 金融产品类型**/ nvl(TEMP.INV_AIM,'999999') invAim,/** 投资目的**/ TEMP.BRANCH branch,/** 分支序号**/ TEMP.O_CCY oCcy,/** 原币**/ TEMP.BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE balFlagHappenDate,/** 余额方向（发生日）**/ TEMP.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE oAmtHappenDate,/** 原币科目余额（发生日）**/ TEMP.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE baseSubjectNature /** 基础科目性质**/ FROM ( SELECT bc.bookset_id, bc.bok_detail_id,
nvl(bdi.BUSI_ID,ddeal.finprod_id) as BUSI_ID,
